def solve():
    n_O = step_0(mass=m_O, molar_mass=M_O)['moles']
    M_acid = 2 * M_C + 4 * M_H + 2 * M_O
    M_water = 2 * M_H + M_O
    oxygen_fraction_acid = 2 * M_O / M_acid
    oxygen_fraction_water = M_O / M_water
    lo = m_O / (2 * max(oxygen_fraction_acid, oxygen_fraction_water))
    hi = m_O / min(oxygen_fraction_acid, oxygen_fraction_water)

    def mismatch(solution_mass):
        solute_mass = step_17(mass_percent=w_percent, solution_mass=solution_mass)['mass']
        solvent_mass = solution_mass - solute_mass
        n_acid = solute_mass / M_acid
        n_water = solvent_mass / M_water
        return 2 * n_acid + n_water - n_O

    solution_mass = solve_for(mismatch, lo, hi)
    solute_mass = step_17(mass_percent=w_percent, solution_mass=solution_mass)['mass']
    solvent_mass = solution_mass - solute_mass
    n_acid = solute_mass / M_acid
    return find(step_373, 'mole_fraction', result=n_acid, solvent_mass=solvent_mass, solvent_molar_mass=M_water)
